map.规则：A=IAi 或 IAIA，B=IBi 或 IBIB，AB=IAIB，O=i:
Rule: A=IAi or IAIA, B=IBi or IBIB, AB=IAIB, O=ii; the child randomly inherits one allele from each parent.
Example: father A (IAi) x mother B (IBi) -> offspring combinations IAIB(AB), IAi(A), IBi(B), ii(O) each 1/4, so each blood type has a 25% probability.
Counterexample: father A (IAi) x mother A (IAi) -> child A 75%, O 25%; B or AB cannot appear.
Conclusion: this tool enumerates all combinations to compute probabilities; Rh negative appears only when both parents carry the recessive gene.
map.父母都是 A 型，孩子可能是 B 型吗？: If both parents are type A, can the child be type B?
map.不可能。若父母均为纯合 IAIA 或杂合 IAi，子代只能获得 IA 或 i，表: Impossible. If both parents are homozygous IAIA or heterozygous IAi, the child can only receive IA or i, so the phenotype can only be A or O; B/AB can never appear. If a contradiction occurs, check for blood-typing errors or kinship.
map.不靠谱。血型与性格无科学关联，本工具的「性格解读」仅为娱乐参考。医学上血型真正的: Not reliable. Blood type has no scientific link to personality; this tool's 'personality reading' is for entertainment only. Medically, blood type truly matters for transfusion compatibility and neonatal hemolytic disease risk (an Rh-negative mother carrying an Rh-positive fetus needs monitoring).
